text: **Hint 1:** Consider the impact of removing the intercept term, \(\hat{\theta}_0\), from the model. How does this affect the model's ability to fit the data, especially when the true relationship between the predictors and the response variable might not pass through the origin?\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about the role of the intercept in a regression model. The intercept allows the model to adjust for the baseline level of the response variable when all predictors are zero. Removing it might force the model to fit through the origin, potentially increasing bias if the true relationship does not naturally pass through the origin.
